## 💼 Industry Experience & Commercial Roles

### 1. Junior Full-Stack Developer — Mereb Technologies
- **Company**: Mereb Technologies (Addis Ababa, Ethiopia | Geo: 9.010793, 38.761252)
- **Tenure**: March 2026 – Present
- **Websites**: https://mereb.tech/ • https://talent.mereb.tech/
- **Responsibilities & Impact**:
  - Architected and deployed the Mereb Talent ATS platform, automating end-to-end candidate pipeline ingestion, resume evaluation, and interview scheduling workflows.
  - Engineered high-throughput, modular REST API services using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript, backed by PostgreSQL with TypeORM relational schema normalization.
  - Implemented asynchronous Redis and Bull background worker queues to process high-volume candidate resume parsing without blocking the main event loop.
  - Built and scaled the official Mereb corporate digital platform utilizing Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS with sub-second page performance.

### 2. Full-Stack & Mobile App Developer — Tech Med
- **Company**: Tech Med (Addis Ababa, Ethiopia | Geo: 9.010793, 38.761252)
- **Tenure**: January 2026 – August 2026
- **Responsibilities & Impact**:
  - Spearheaded technical architecture, mobile engineering, and production deployment of Jegnit, a bilingual maternal health and fetal development tracking platform launched on Google Play Store.
  - Implemented robust offline-first synchronization using local SQLite storage, ensuring uninterrupted health tracking across low-connectivity regional environments.
  - Developed scalable REST API microservices with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, powering authenticated user profiles and scheduled clinical notification feeds.
  - Managed end-to-end mobile release pipelines, automated build signing, and successfully deployed and maintained the production release on Google Play.
